items.a: No. Every detail on this build is invented. It is a test fixture for the header lockup rule and the gallery route.

items.q: Why is the business name so long?
items.a: That is the fixture. The name sits near the measured two-line bound for the header lockup, so a change that narrows the budget fails check:textfit here before it reaches a real client.
